themes.subtitle: Sustained rally in cloud infrastructure ETFs

themes.name: Energy
themes.subtitle: Energy sector benefits from commodity price strength
themes.thesis: XLE delivered an 8.4% 20‑day gain and an 11.6% 60‑day gain, outpacing SPY by 5.0pp, with a modest 21.0 P/E, indicating a value‑driven upside near its 52‑week high. themes.synthesis: Energy ETF (XLE) up 8.4% versus SPY +5.0pp, indicating broad market recognition; crowding is rising and climate‑policy risk is becoming a material factor. Sustained multi‑week gains and proximity to 52‑week high suggest the rally is approaching its peak.
